outcome: Incidence and prevalence of meconium ileus (MI) in cystic fibrosis patients
Most common gene mutation of MI in CF patients
Survival rate of CF patients with MI
cohort: 40 patients with cystic fibrosis (CF) who presented with meconium ileus (MI) between 1989 and 2018
finding: CFTR mutations were identified in all patients with CF and MI, and prognosis is similar to CF patients without MI if treated early.
